easy.q: What number is in the title of Ariana Grande's 2019 No. 1 hit "___ Rings"?
easy.fact: It interpolates "My Favorite Things" from The Sound of Music.

easy.q: In Dr. Seuss's How the Grinch Stole Christmas!, the Grinch's heart grows how many sizes that day?
easy.fact: Dr. Seuss published the book in 1957.

easy.q: How many digits are in a U.S. telephone area code?
easy.fact: New York City's 212 was one of the original area codes created in 1947.

easy.q: Kwanzaa, which begins each Dec. 26, lasts how many days?
easy.fact: Each day honors one of its seven principles, starting with unity.

easy.q: In golf, an eagle is how many strokes under par on a hole?
easy.fact: One stroke under par is a birdie; three under is an albatross.

medium.q: How many Matrix movies starring Keanu Reeves as Neo have been released, through 2021's The Matrix Resurrections?
medium.fact: The first film came out in 1999; two sequels followed in 2003.

medium.q: What jersey number did Derek Jeter wear for the New York Yankees?
medium.fact: When the Yankees retired it in 2017, every single-digit number was retired.

medium.q: Louisiana is divided into parishes instead of counties. How many parishes does it have?
medium.fact: Alaska is the other state without counties; it uses boroughs.

medium.q: Which-numbered amendment to the U.S. Constitution abolished slavery?
In what year was the holiday classic It's a Wonderful Life released?
medium.fact: It flopped at first and became a classic through TV reruns.

hard.q: In what year did the Great Chicago Fire burn much of the city?
hard.fact: Legend blames Mrs. O'Leary's cow, but the cause was never proven.

hard.q: To the nearest 5 miles, how long is New York's Hudson River?
hard.fact: It starts at Lake Tear of the Clouds in the Adirondacks.

hard.q: Rickey Henderson holds MLB's career record for stolen bases. How many did he steal?
hard.fact: No other player has reached even 1,000.

hard.q: Counting all DLC, how many playable fighters are in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate?
hard.fact: Its final fighter, Sora from Kingdom Hearts, arrived in 2021.
